headline: Treasuries jump 12bp but the 10Y INDOGB holds at 7.69% (+0.2bp) as the rupiah steadies (JISDOR 18,218) and the JCI rallies 1.8%; the 2–3Y cheapen ~3bp and the daily flow signal stays in sell-off at −0.76
summary: PHEI's IGSYC bear-flattened again but far less than Thursday: the 1Y rose 1.5bp to 6.791%, the 2Y 2.8bp to 7.048%, the 3Y 2.7bp to 7.215% and the 5Y 1.6bp to 7.469%, while the 10Y added only 0.2bp to 7.692% and 15–30Y 0.1bp, so 2s5s narrowed to 42.1bp (from 43.3bp) and 5s10s to 22.3bp (from 23.6bp). On the week the 10Y is 1.2bp lower and the 5Y 0.3bp lower, but this month the 10Y is up 6.4bp and sits in the 98th percentile of the past year. Benchmark FR0109 lost another 2.8bp to 7.467% and is 7.0bp cheap to the curve, while FR0108 gained 1.8bp to 7.597% and is 8.7bp rich, so the market keeps buying the 10Y benchmark and selling the 5Y. The fitted PBS curve is 2.1bp over IGSYC at 2Y and 0.5bp through at 5Y, the retail fit 11.2bp rich at 5Y, and AAA 3Y rose 2.3bp to 7.703%, 48.8bp over, the narrowest of eleven stored days.
drivers: Treasuries sold off; INDOGBs did not follow

The US 10Y rose about 12bp to 5.10% on Thursday (2Y about +15bp) as a December Fed hike became fully priced, the first New York close since Tuesday. At the 1-year daily beta of 0.30 that implies +3.6bp for the INDOGB 10Y (about +2.3bp at the 0.19 median pass-through on big US days); it moved +0.2bp, so Treasuries 'explain' more than the whole move and INDOGBs outperformed by about 3bp. The INDOGB − UST spread fell to 259bp from 271bp (75th percentile of 52 weeks), a nominal pick-up before currency risk.
A steadier rupiah capped the damage

JISDOR eased 0.13% to 18,218 from Thursday's 18,241 record and spot closed 0.18% firmer at 18,206, against a dollar that stayed strong elsewhere in Asia. With the currency no longer making new lows, the 2–3Y cheapened only 2.7–2.8bp after Thursday's 6–7bp; dealers marking the belly lower ahead of BI (Nov 17–18) rather than outright foreign selling is my hypothesis, as buyer-level data are not published.
JCI rallied, but foreigners sold stocks

The JCI rose 1.78% to 5,344.41, Asia's best market on the day and up 5.82% on the week, yet foreigners net sold Rp229.8bn across the market (BBRI, TLKM and BBCA led), after a Rp443.5bn net buy on Thursday. The equity rally looks domestic, so it says little about foreign appetite for INDOGBs; the 20-session JCI change is still −12.0%.
Softer US PPI after the close

US October PPI rose 0.3% m/m (forecast 0.4%, prior 1.4%) and 6.5% y/y; core was 0.3% as expected. It landed after the PHEI close, so it is a Monday input: a small relief for Treasuries would ease the catch-up risk from Thursday's move, though the next-day spill-over beta is only 0.065.
data: Slight miss; after the PHEI close. Does not change December Fed-hike pricing on its own.
BRPT, BRMS out of Standard; 7 out of Small Cap (f BRPT, BRMS deletions expected; p index freeze)
In line; est. Rp1–1.2tn passive outflow on Nov 30. Standalone risk unchanged.
Pushed the US 10Y back above 5%; the dollar is the rupiah's main headwind.
Bids Rp79.71tn (p Rp31.09tn); awarded Rp35tn vs Rp30tn target; FR0110 7.44%, FR0111 7.68%
Strong demand at higher yields; foreign bids 22.6% of the book. FR0109 at 7.47% is now above FR0110's auction yield.
Soft consumption argues against hikes for growth reasons.
My read, not a BI commitment: BI has room to smooth the rupiah, and 18,200–18,250 is where it has paused.
A beat: no growth case for an early cut.
view: INDOGBs absorbed a 12bp Treasury sell-off with almost no move in the 10Y, which tells me the rupiah, not Treasuries, is the binding input this week; the cost showed up only in the 2–3Y, where BI-hike risk lives. The daily Bond Flow Signal is −0.76 (sell-off): the 10Y trend (z +2.08, +59bp over 20 sessions) and the JCI (z −1.21, −12.0%) are bearish, the rupiah (z +0.43, +1.48%) mildly so, and the spread, 17.4bp above its 130-day average (z +0.66), is the one bond-bullish part. After today's rebuild the sell-off episode runs from Sep 30 (21 sessions, +59.0bp so far). Since June 2022 the daily signal scores a Sharpe of 0.67 outright and 0.76 hedged against Treasuries, but sell-off calls were right only 51% of the time over the next 20 sessions (rally calls 58%; hedged 64%), and its daily Sharpe fell from 1.06 in 2022–Aug 2024 to 0.40 since; the weekly build scores 0.35 and 0.44, and the US-trend variants reach 0.79 and 0.80 on the weekly build but were chosen after the fact and are not live; all are in-sample back-tests. Over four weeks the US 10Y is unchanged, so at the weekly beta of −0.21 none of the INDOGB 10Y's +52.7bp is Treasury-linked: all of it is the part Treasuries do not explain. I stay neutral on the 10Y in a 7.55–7.80% range for two weeks and keep the 5Y as the curve trade: buy FR0109 at 7.60–7.70% after BI rather than adding 1–2Y now.

buckets.name: Front end 1–2Y vs BI-Rate
buckets.why: The IGSYC 1Y rose 1.5bp to 6.791%, 104.1bp over the 5.75% BI-Rate (25th percentile of 12 stored days, average 109.0bp), still above my 6.75% no-chase line; the 2Y rose 2.8bp to 7.048% and 1s2s widened to 25.7bp, the steepest of 12 days. The 3M (0.25Y) is 6.28% and the 1M 6.17%. The 7.10% add level was not reached (31bp away); no position.
buckets.call: Neutral. Add 1–2Y only at 1Y 7.10% or after a BI hike that steadies JISDOR; a hike on Nov 18 would hit this bucket first.

buckets.name: Belly 5Y (FR0109 / PBS040)
buckets.why: The IGSYC 5Y rose 1.6bp to 7.469% (50th percentile of 12 stored days, average 7.492%), 5.3bp lower this month; the 2s5s10s fly is 19.8bp (50th percentile, average 25.5bp). FR0109 fell another 2.8bp to 7.467% and is 7.0bp cheap to the curve; PBS040 at 7.477% is 11.9bp cheap. The entry (FR0109 7.60–7.70%) is 13bp away and not filled.
buckets.call: Buy FR0109 at 7.60–7.70% after a BI hike or with JISDOR back below 18,000; target 7.35%, stop 7.95%.

buckets.name: 10Y outright
buckets.why: The IGSYC 10Y rose 0.2bp to 7.692%, 98th percentile of the past year (172 days, average 6.80%) and 3.3bp under the 7.724% high of Nov 4, despite a 12bp US sell-off. The signal is −0.76, but the underweight rule also needs a 10Y close above 7.75%, so it is not triggered. FR0108 gained 1.8bp to 7.597% and is 8.7bp rich.
buckets.call: Neutral, range 7.55–7.80%. Underweight if the signal stays below −0.5 and the 10Y closes above 7.75%; tactical long only above 7.85% (stop 8.05%) or once the signal is above 0 with JISDOR below 18,000.

buckets.name: 10s20s curve (FR0108 vs FR0107)
buckets.why: IGSYC 10s20s is 2.0bp (67th percentile of 12 stored days, average 1.4bp, range 0.1–2.9bp); the range is tiny. The benchmark spread FR0107 − FR0108 widened to 13.2bp from 5.2bp as FR0107 lost 6.2bp and FR0108 gained 1.8bp, moving further from the −5bp re-entry (18bp away).
buckets.call: Wait. Re-enter the FR0108/FR0107 steepener duration-weighted at −5bp or lower, target +5bp, stop −12bp.

buckets.name: PBS sukuk vs FR
buckets.stance: FR over PBS034 at the long end
buckets.why: The fitted PBS 5Y is 0.5bp through IGSYC (64th percentile of 11 stored days, average −1.8bp), the 2Y 2.1bp over and the 10Y 2.2bp through; the fit rests on four series (level −4.1bp, slope 9.9bp), so confidence is limited. PBS034 rose 1.2bp to 7.619% and is 6.3bp rich, PBS040 11.9bp cheap. The switch-back condition (PBS034 5bp cheap) is not met; the position stays open and roughly flat.
buckets.call: Hold FR over PBS034; switch back once PBS034 is 5bp cheap to IGSYC. PBS040 at ~12bp cheap suits buy-and-hold accounts.

buckets.name: Corporate credit (AAA 3Y)
buckets.why: PHEI's AAA 3Y rose 2.3bp to 7.703%, 48.8bp over IGSYC, the narrowest of 11 stored days (9th percentile, average 50.5bp). AA widened to 88.8bp (the widest of 11 days), A is 152.8bp over, and BBB 227.3bp over AA (the narrowest, average 241.4bp). Eleven days is a thin base; the add level (AAA 3Y past 70bp) was not reached.
buckets.call: Hold AAA/AA; add only if AAA 3Y widens past 70bp. Avoid BBB until the rupiah and politics settle.

buckets.name: Retail SBN 5Y (ORI/SR)
buckets.why: The fitted retail curve is 11.2bp through IGSYC at 5Y (64th percentile of 11 stored days, average −13.6bp) and 9.9bp over at 2Y; the 21-series fit has an 80bp slope, so part of this is fit artefact. Secondary spreads run from 57bp rich (SR024T3) to 42bp cheap (ORI027T3); ORI026T6 is 7.591%, 30bp over. ST017 (open to Dec 2) floors at 6.95% (2Y) and 7.05% (4Y), now below the IGSYC 2Y (7.05%).
buckets.call: For new money, FR0109 or PBS040 give daily liquidity; ST017 suits hold-to-maturity buyers who want BI-hike upside. Buy secondary retail only at the cheap end (ORI026T6, ~30bp over).

watch: Next: Indonesia's October trade balance (mid-November), BI's board meeting (Tue–Wed Nov 17–18), the MPR's process to fill the vice presidency (within 60 days of Nov 12), US retail sales and FOMC minutes in the week of Nov 16, MSCI changes effective after the Nov 30 close and the ST017 book closing Dec 2; a 10Y close above 7.75% would trigger the underweight, while JISDOR back below 18,000 would push a BI hike out.
